mapper.sql: node_run_id AS nodeRunId, instance_id AS instanceId, node_key AS nodeKey, node_type AS nodeType, round_no AS roundNo, branch_key AS branchKey, previous_node_run_id AS previousNodeRunId, status, selected_edge_key AS selectedEdgeKey, activated_time AS activatedTime, completed_time AS completedTime, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_node_run (node_run_id, instance_id, node_key, node_type, round_no, branch_key, previous_node_run_id, status, selected_edge_key, activated_time, completed_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.nodeRunId}, #{row.instanceId}, #{row.nodeKey}, #{row.nodeType}, #{row.roundNo}, #{row.branchKey}, #{row.previousNodeRunId}, #{row.status}, #{row.selectedEdgeKey}, #{row.activatedTime}, #{row.completedTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_node_run WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY activated_time, node_run_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_workflow_node_run SET status = #{to}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} AND status = #{from}
